items.name: error-detective
items.title: Error Detective
items.description: Use this agent when you need errors, stack traces, and logs correlated across services or files to find the root cause of an incident or recurring failure. Cross-references timestamps, traces request IDs across boundaries, and surfaces the originating cause rather than the downstream symptom. Works from runtime artifacts where the debugger agent works from source; use when the failure is in production or staging and you cannot step through the code.
items.author: Khaled Saeed
